reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), last_year AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a sale on the same days a year earlier
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - INTERVAL '1 year' AND p.end_date - INTERVAL '1 year'
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(d.units, 0) - COALESCE(l.units, 0) AS uplift_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(d.units, 0) - COALESCE(l.units, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(l.units, 0), 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN last_year l ON l.promo_id = p.promo_id

    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0)

       AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - INTERVAL '1 year' AND p.end_date - INTERVAL '1 year') AS last_year_units
  FROM promo p
)
SELECT promo_id, units - last_year_units AS uplift_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * (units - last_year_units) / NULLIF(last_year_units, 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM sums

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), on_promo AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM sales s
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
), ly AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date >= CAST(p.start_date - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
    AND s.order_date <= CAST(p.end_date - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), x AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(o.units, 0) AS ty, COALESCE(l.units, 0) AS lyu
  FROM promo p
  LEFT JOIN on_promo o ON o.promo_id = p.promo_id
  LEFT JOIN ly l ON l.promo_id = p.promo_id
)
SELECT promo_id, ty - lyu AS uplift_units,
  CASE WHEN lyu > 0 THEN ROUND((ty - lyu) * 100.0 / lyu, 1) END AS uplift_pct
FROM x
